FAQ
A Few Things
Worth Knowing
  • Who is Uniify for?
    Independent artists, producers, and songwriters who want a clearer plan for their music career.
  • What does the assessment cover?
    Six foundations: releases, rights, identity, audience, money, and goals. It checks your practices, not your talent.
  • How is my roadmap created?
    Your assessment and goals generate general career recommendations. Create a release to add preparation, production, delivery, promotion and review tasks. Completing actions or changing availability adjusts unfinished suggested work using repeatable rules. Your chosen dates stay fixed; conflicts are flagged and automatic scheduling changes can be undone. Your assessment informs the plan without blocking a release.
  • Where is my progress saved?
    Signed-in workspaces save privately to your account and load on another device. The demo saves only in your browser. Export your data from Settings & data to keep a copy.
  • Does Uniify distribute my music?
    No. Uniify currently helps with assessment, planning, and progress. Distribution and industry placements are not included.
